Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I consolidated input and attached the final comms draft (role-consolidation-redline.docx with accepted edits) and a one-pager for the QBR (attached as pillar-mapping-v2.pdf). Highlights and the public paragraph are below.

Public paragraph (for org email and external partners):
"Today we are clarifying ownership for two operational pillars to improve response time and reduce duplicated work across teams. These changes focus on accountability and transparency; they do not result in immediate changes to individual contributors' roles or compensation. We will share updated owners and escalation paths in the coming week and will publish an FAQ to address headcount and SLAs."

QBR talking points (short):
- Why: duplicate effort across Platform Ops and Serving Runtime has increased mean time to resolution on infra incidents; stewardship clarifies who owns what.
- What: two pillars will have named stewards; Platform Stewardship will absorb Edge Serving ownership.
- Impact: no immediate personnel changes; expected execution efficiency gains in Q4; headcount impact likely neutral — Finance is validating.
- Risks: hiring velocity, legal review of vendor contracts, short-term ramp on runbooks.

Next steps by owners:
- Rishi: finalize headcount impact and sign off on FAQ language (7/19).
- Marissa: finalize customer-facing FAQ and draft internal FAQ for managers (7/20).
- Jonas: lead Exec readout on 7/25; Soojin will run the operational Q&A.

Attachments: pillar-mapping-v2.pdf, role-consolidation-redline.docx, headcount-impact.xlsx

If there are no further objections I will send the pre-announce to leads on 7/20 and the public org email on 7/27.
